race.comment: ROMEO'S CHOICE (3) underrated gelding who saves his best for this track and trip. Sat on the pace with the 57.5kg to get up in a tight finish over today's track and trip on the heavy (9) surface. Adept in all conditions and sure to go close. BANDI'S BOY (16) will appreciate the fast tempo on the improving track after launching late when second over 1300m at Randwick last Saturday. Drops 7.5kg for this and no shock to see him score a well deserved victory. DARK GLITTER (6) slashing win here two-back over the 1200m, then never looked at home on the heavy (9) surface with a respectable sixth over this course and distance. Well placed with the 3kg claimer and expected to bounce back. STYLISH (11) racing well this prep in Victoria and comes here fourth-up with a jump out win over 800m at Flemington. Will go back from the wide draw and be ridden for luck. CIGAR FLICK (1) can never be underestimated in a race of this calibre and looking for the 1300m now. Stays in the mix.
